name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A tool that stops AI coding agents from 'forgetting' your project between sessions, and trims the noisy tool output that otherwise clogs up their memory.
buyer: An indie developer or small dev team running long AI coding sessions across multiple tools who's frustrated with agents losing context.
business_use_cases: An indie developer uses it so their AI pair programmer remembers last week's decisions instead of needing everything re-explained each session.
A dev agency standardizes on it across client projects so every AI agent session starts with full prior context, cutting re-explanation time billed to clients.
A platform team adopts it to let agents coordinate across 17 different tools via one shared memory layer instead of building custom integrations per tool.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted team-memory service — shared context across a whole engineering team's AI agents — as a per-seat subscription.

steal_this: Package it with a simple onboarding script for one popular tool like Cursor and sell a 'never lose your AI agent's memory again' $15/month add-on this weekend.
